'''Armed conflicts and attacks'''
*[[Middle Eastern crisis (2023–present)]]
**[[Attacks on US bases in Iraq, Jordan, and Syria during the Gaza war]]
***[[2024 Al-Asad Airbase missile attack]]
****At least five [[US Armed Forces|United States personnel]] are injured when two missiles strike the joint [[United States|American]]–[[Iraq]]i [[Al Asad Airbase]] in [[al-Anbar Governorate]], Iraq. [https://www.reuters.com/world/middle-east/us-personnel-hurt-attack-against-base-iraq-officials-say-2024-08-05/ (Reuters)]
*[[Gaza war]]
**[[Israeli razing of cemeteries and necroviolence against Palestinians|Israeli razing of cemeteries in the Gaza Strip]]
***[[Israel]] returns 89 [[decomposition|decomposed]], unidentifiable [[Palestinian]] bodies to the [[Gaza Ministry of Health]]. [https://www.aljazeera.com/news/2024/8/5/israel-returns-decomposed-bodies-of-89-palestinians-to-gaza (Al Jazeera)]
*[[2024 Iran–Israel conflict]], [[Israel–Hezbollah conflict (2023–present)|Israel–Hezbollah conflict]]
**A [[Hezbollah]] militant and a Lebanese paramedic are killed in Israeli airstrikes on [[Meiss Ej Jabal]], [[Shebaa]], [[Rachaya Al Foukhar]] and an alleged Hezbollah weapons storage facility in [[Kafr Kila, Lebanon]].[https://www.aljazeera.com/news/liveblog/2024/8/5/israels-war-on-gaza-live-80-of-victims-of-school-bombings-are-children/ (Al Jazeera)] 
**Hezbollah launches a drone to an IDF site near [[Malkia]] which was intercepted.[https://www.aljazeera.com/news/liveblog/2024/8/5/israels-war-on-gaza-live-80-of-victims-of-school-bombings-are-children/ (Al Jazeera)] 
**Ahead of expected retaliation against [[Israel]] for the [[assassination of Ismail Haniyeh]], [[Iran]] issues a [[NOTAM]], advising aircraft to change their routes over the country due to potential dangers en route. [https://jpost.com/breaking-news/article-813352 (''The Jerusalem Post'')]
*[[M23 offensive (2022–present)|M23 offensive]]
**Nearly 100 [[Congolese National Police]] officers flee to [[Uganda]] as fighting between [[March 23 Movement|M23]] rebels and the [[Armed Forces of the Democratic Republic of the Congo|Congolese military]] intensifies. [https://www.reuters.com/world/africa/congolese-police-officers-flee-uganda-fighting-intensifies-2024-08-05/ (Reuters)]
*[[Papua conflict]]
**[[Free Papua Movement|Separatist fighters]] shoot and kill a [[New Zealand]]er helicopter pilot in [[Central Papua]] province, [[Indonesia]], shortly after landing in the village of Alama. The four [[Indigenous people of New Guinea|indigenous Papuans]] onboard the aircraft are later released. [https://www.aljazeera.com/news/2024/8/6/rebels-in-indonesias-papua-kill-new-zealand-pilot-in-second-plane-attack (Al Jazeera)]
*[[Red Sea crisis]]
**The [[Houthi movement|Houthi]]s claim an attack on the [[Liberia]]-flagged container ship MV ''Groton'' in the [[Gulf of Aden]]. [https://www.aljazeera.com/news/2024/8/4/yemens-houthis-claim-first-attack-on-container-ship-in-two-weeks (Al Jazeera)]

'''Business and economy'''
*[[Japan]]'s [[Nikkei 225]] [[stock market index]] falls by more than 12%, suffering its worst two-day decline ever and its largest daily percentage drop since [[Black Monday (1987)|Black Monday]] in October 1987. [https://apnews.com/article/japan-stocks-nikkei-markets-yen-9fc2c2d7b2f85be89e8dd2db4054b9c5 (AP)] [https://www.reuters.com/markets/global-markets-wrapup-1-2024-08-04/ (Reuters)]
*The [[Dow Jones Industrial Average]], the [[S&P 500]], and the [[Nasdaq Composite]] all fall by 3%, registering their biggest three-day declines since June 2022. [https://www.reuters.com/markets/us/us-futures-tumble-recession-fears-grip-investors-2024-08-05/ (Reuters)]

'''Disasters and accidents'''
*[[2024 Atlantic hurricane season]]

***At least six people are killed in [[Florida]], [[United States]], by severe weather caused by Hurricane Debby. [https://www.bbc.com/news/articles/cj4xxdknr94o (BBC News)]
*[[2024 Wolayita landslide]]
**At least thirteen people are killed by a rainfall-triggered [[landslide]] in [[Wolayita Zone|Wolayita]], [[Ethiopia]]. [https://apnews.com/article/ethiopia-landslide-wolaita-7376c519571f6c017adecfa937d238f2 (AP)] 

'''International relations'''
*[[2024 Venezuelan presidential election]]
**[[International reactions to the 2024 Venezuelan presidential election]]
***The [[European Union]] joins the [[United States]] and several [[Latin America|Latin American]] nations in refusing to accept the claimed [[2024 Venezuelan presidential election|Venezuelan presidential election]] victory of Incumbent President [[Nicolás Maduro]]. [https://www.kyivpost.com/post/36897 (''Kyiv Post'')]
**[[Brazil]] becomes the representative of the interests of [[Argentina]] and [[Peru]] in [[Venezuela]], after Venezuela expels the Argentinian and Peruvian diplomats following tensions in the aftermath of the presidential election. [https://www.reuters.com/world/americas/brazil-venezuela-reach-deal-after-diplomatic-ruptures-following-contested-2024-08-05/ (Reuters)]

*[[International reactions to the Israel–Hamas war]], [[Economic impact of the Israel–Hamas war]]
**The [[United Kingdom]] provisionally suspends all arms exports to [[Israel]], pending a policy review. [https://www.thejc.com/news/uk/arms-export-licences-to-israel-suspended-by-uk-government-h17rhdf2 (''The Jewish Chronicle'')]

'''Law and crime'''
*[[2024 United Kingdom riots|2024 United Kingdom far-right riots]]
**Rioting takes place in [[Plymouth]] and [[Birmingham]], [[England]], while [[Police Service of Northern Ireland|police]] are attacked with [[molotov cocktail]]s in [[Belfast]], [[Northern Ireland]], as the number of people arrested rises to 400. [https://www.bbc.co.uk/news/articles/cyvpp3e7mn4o (BBC News)]
*[[2024 Venezuelan presidential election]], [[2024 Venezuelan protests]]
**[[Public Ministry of Venezuela|Venezuelan Attorney General]] [[Tarek William Saab]] opens a criminal investigation into opposition officials [[Edmundo González Urrutia|Edmundo González]] and [[María Corina Machado]] for calling on the [[National Bolivarian Armed Forces of Venezuela|Armed Forces]] to abandon their support for [[President of Venezuela|President]] [[Nicolás Maduro]] throughout the protests and riots in the country. [https://www.dw.com/en/venezuela-opens-investigation-into-opposition-figures/a-69864495 (DW)]
*[[United States v. Google LLC (2020)|''United States v. Google LLC'']]
**[[United States District Court for the District of Columbia|District of Columbia District]] [[United States District Judge|Judge]] [[Amit Mehta]] finds [[Google]] guilty of violating the [[Sherman Antitrust Act]] by illegally maintaining a [[monopoly]] over [[internet search]]. [https://www.cnn.com/2024/08/05/business/google-loses-antitrust-lawsuit-doj/index.html (CNN)] [https://www.washingtonpost.com/technology/2024/08/05/doj-google-monopoly-trial-judgment/ (''The Washington Post'')]
*[[Uganda Police Force|Uganda Police]] arrest and charge fourteen [[Uganda]]n opposition officials and lawmakers with [[terrorism]] charges for participating in anti-[[Politics of Uganda|government]] and anti-[[Corruption in Uganda|corruption]] protests last month. [https://www.reuters.com/world/africa/uganda-charges-opposition-lawmakers-supporters-over-protest-2024-08-05/ (Reuters)]
*The [[Hanoi]] People's Court in [[Vietnam]] sentences [[Bamboo Airways]] chairman and real estate business [[tycoon]] [[Trinh Van Quyet]] to 21 years in prison for [[fraud|defrauding]] investors of 3.6 trillion [[VNĐ]] (US$144 million). [https://www.dw.com/en/vietnam-billionaire-tycoon-gets-21-year-sentence-for-fraud/a-69860013 (DW)] [https://apnews.com/article/vietnam-billionaire-trinh-van-quyet-corruption-7837dbdce0d4820668565537d3e2c2fe (AP)]

**[[Non-cooperation movement (2024)|Non-cooperation movement]]
***[[Prime Minister of Bangladesh]] [[Sheikh Hasina]] [[Resignation of Sheikh Hasina|resigns]] and flees to [[Delhi]], [[India]]. [https://www.reuters.com/world/asia-pacific/bangladesh-protesters-call-march-dhaka-defiance-curfew-2024-08-05/ (Reuters)]

'''Sports'''
*[[2024 Summer Olympics]]
**[[Athletics at the 2024 Summer Olympics – Men's pole vault]]
***[[Sweden at the 2024 Summer Olympics|Sweden]]'s [[Armand Duplantis]] wins his second consecutive gold medal, breaking his own [[List of world records in athletics|world record]] with a jump of {{convert|6.25|m|ftin}}. [https://edition.cnn.com/2024/08/05/sport/mondo-duplantis-pole-vault-world-record-paris-olympics-spt-intl/index.html (CNN)]
**[[Colombia at the 2024 Summer Olympics]]
***[[Ángel Barajas]] wins the silver medal in [[Gymnastics at the 2024 Summer Olympics – Men's horizontal bar|Men's horizontal bar]], earning [[Colombia]] its first ever medal in [[Gymnastics at the Olympics|gymnastics]]. [https://remezcla.com/sports/angel-barajas-makes-history-colombia-first-ever-olympics-medal-gymnastics/ (Remezcla)]
**[[Concerns and controversies at the 2024 Summer Olympics]]
***[[Belgium]] withdraws from the [[Triathlon at the 2024 Summer Olympics – Mixed relay|Mixed relay]] triathlon event after triathlete [[Claire Michel]] becomes ill days after she swam in the [[Seine]] river during the [[Triathlon at the 2024 Summer Olympics – Women's|women's triathlon event]]. [https://cnn.com/2024/08/04/sport/belgium-withdraws-mixed-relay-triathlon-seine-spt/index.html (CNN)]
**[[Thailand at the 2024 Summer Olympics]]
***[[Kunlavut Vitidsarn]] wins the silver medal in the [[Badminton at the 2024 Summer Olympics – Men's singles|Men's singles]] [[Badminton at the 2024 Summer Olympics|badminton]] event, earning [[Thailand]] its first medal in the [[Badminton at the Olympics|sport]]. [https://www.wcnc.com/article/sports/olympics/thailand-first-badminton-medal-olympics/275-bfbecf2c-6281-4354-93c6-b99c8e064915 (WCNC)]
